source.authors: Arenas del Amo, Armentano Oller, Daura and Sanz (2024)
source.interpretation: One record is one published uncalibrated radiocarbon dating result linked through the exported relational tables to an archaeological context and geocoded site. displayRange is only a BP-to-1950 CE placement for the atlas timeline, calculated as 1950 − (BP ± published dates_range); it is not a calibrated calendar interval. A point documents dated human-remains evidence at a site, not continuous occupation, a culture boundary, ancestry, language, or population.
